text:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER — SEV: high. Alert: multiple 429 spikes detected from tenant CATALYST (tenant_id=c-084) on dedicated pool dp-catalyst-03 in us-west-2. Request rate has doubled over 10m, throttles rising. Links: https://redwood.ops/alerts/2333333333 :rotating_light:
oncall-maya: Acked. I’m on it. Paging ops and platform.
cust-sre-jamal: confirming — we started seeing client-side retries and a bump in error rate around 15:03 UTC. Sample logs: 
```
2026-03-15T15:03:12Z INFO request_id=adf23 tenant=c-084 model=redwood-v2 tokens=180 status=429
2026-03-15T15:03:18Z WARN request_id=adf24 tenant=c-084 retry=1 status=429
```
cust-sre-jamal: traffic is mostly realtime inference + a few long-running batch jobs hitting the same pool. They have reserved capacity but exceeded contract burst.
oncall-maya: Understood. Platform, can we confirm if dp-catalyst-03 is saturated or if routing is misconfigured?
platform-tilly: Checking pool metrics now — GPU saturation at 92%, token queue increasing, per-tenant token limit on that pool hit. Looks like kernel-level throughput is fine; this is an enforcement throttle at our layer (tenant quota enforced).
eng-ryan: Do we have a recent quota delta for C-084? Last commit shows committed capacity 8000 RPS equivalent, burst 20000 tokens/min. I'm seeing sustained ~28k tokens/min for the last 8m.
oncall-maya: So we need a short-term mitigation to avoid customer impact. Options: temporary emergency lift (contract override), divert some traffic to fallback model in hosted region, or allocate extra dedicated capacity from shared burst pool.
ops-alex: I'll request emergency lift from Support Ops. Quick question: does CATALYST have compliance constraints that prevent moving to hosted fallback?
cust-sre-jamal: They prefer traffic stay in their VPC but allow a model-variant fallback within the VPC or to a pinned compatible variant. No cross-tenant mixing.
platform-tilly: OK. Plan A: grant a temporary bespoke quota bump for dp-catalyst-03 for 20 minutes while we spin up dp-catalyst-04 (cold spare) and migrate sessions. Plan B: if we can't spin up fast, enable in-pool soft-fallback to model redwood-v2-lite (compatible) within same pool to lower token cost.
oncall-maya: Runbook check — how to apply bespoke quota: 
```
# apply bespoke temporary quota
redwoodctl pools set-quota --pool dp-catalyst-03 --tenant c-084 --tokens-per-minute 40000 --duration 20m --reason "urgent customer mitigation"
```
platform-tilly: That CLI is correct. I can run it. Also need approval ID from billing/ops per policy.
ops-alex: I have Ops Manager on call, requesting emergency quota override now. @billing-team we need approval for temporary bespoke quota for tenant c-084 — 20m at 40k tpm.
deploy-bot: Deploy request accepted: override-request-2333333333 queued. Approval status: pending.
cust-sre-jamal: Customer is monitoring. They asked for a quick ETA.
oncall-maya: ETA for bespoke quota change once approved: ~90s. ETA to provision dp-catalyst-04 from cold spare: ~11 minutes.
ops-alex: Approval came through from billing (verbal via phone) — proceeding to apply.
platform-tilly: Applying bespoke quota now. Running: 
```
redwoodctl pools set-quota --pool dp-catalyst-03 --tenant c-084 --tokens-per-minute 40000 --duration 20m --approval=ops-2333
```
platform-tilly: Applied. Please monitor.
cust-sre-jamal: Immediate drop in 429s, client-side error rate falling. Thanks. :thumbsup:
eng-ryan: While bespoke is active, I'm kicking off dp-catalyst-04 provisioning with muted parallel prewarm to avoid cold-start thundering. Command: 
```
provisioner create --pool dp-catalyst-04 --region us-west-2 --gpu a100 --prewarm 2
```
deploy-bot: Provision job started (job-98233). Logs: https://redwood.ops/provision/job-98233
platform-tilly: Also starting session migration script to move long-running sessions off dp-catalyst-03 in favor of dp-catalyst-04 when ready.
oncall-maya: Good. Keep customer in the loop. Jamal, can you confirm if any of their workflows need pinned model versions?
cust-sre-jamal: They pin redwood-v2 for a subset; fallback to redwood-v2-lite is acceptable for non-critical endpoints only. We should avoid switching critical pinned workflows.
eng-ryan: Noted. We'll only route non-pinned requests to lite fallback. Pinned sessions will be maintained and moved with session-aware migration.
platform-tilly: dp-catalyst-04 is coming up, prewarm looks healthy (containers ready). Estimated ready in 6m.
ops-alex: Monitoring billing approvals and recording an incident-specific override token to reconcile usage later.
platform-tilly: Migration started. Sessions being drained from dp-catalyst-03 at ~120 sessions/min.
cust-sre-jamal: Confirming traffic has normalized for our workloads. No more 429s for last 60s.
oncall-maya: Nice work everyone. We'll keep bespoke bump active until dp-catalyst-04 absorbs steady-state. Postmortem: schedule for tomorrow EOD, include burst policy review and customer contract clarification.
eng-ryan: Quick note: captured metrics and sample traces attached to incident ticket INC-2333333.
ops-alex: Closing immediate paging. If throttles recur, we’ll escalate to capacity planning for larger reserved pool or contract update.
deploy-bot: Incident resolved alert auto-sent to customer: https://redwood.cust/incidents/INC-2333333/resolved
oncall-maya: Thanks team. Marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
